# proxmox_notification_matcher (Resource)

Manages a notification matcher through `/cluster/notifications/matchers`. A matcher routes matching notifications to one or more targets; clear all match rules to match everything.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_notification_matcher" "errors" {
  name           = "errors-to-ops"
  target         = [proxmox_notification_endpoint_sendmail.ops.name]
  match_severity = ["error"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stable matcher name (`pve-configid`). Changes require replacement.
- `target` (Set of String) Target endpoints (built-in names or `proxmox_notification_endpoint_*` names).

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this matcher.
- `invert_match` (Boolean) Send notifications that do **not** match the rules.
- `match_calendar` (Set of String) Calendar matchers in systemd calendar syntax.
- `match_field` (Set of String) Field matchers such as `type=system` or `hostname=node1`.
- `match_severity` (Set of String) Severities: `info`, `notice`, `warning`, `error`, `unknown`.
- `mode` (String) `all` requires every rule to match, `any` one of them. The Proxmox default is `all`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Matcher name.
